summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Meta Semanal' feature on Home ('/'). All 7 requested behaviors verified as guest with seeded localStorage sessions. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Home.js is ~380 lines, still manageable but growing. Consider extracting WeeklyGoalCard and StreakCard into their own components (`components/home/*`) for maintainability.
GOAL_KEY parsing uses parseInt without validating NaN explicitly, but the range check `v >= 1 && v <= 7` correctly rejects NaN. OK.
daysThisWeek computes week start using ((day+6)%7) locally — correct Monday-Sunday behavior, consistent with streak logic. Good.
Dots use inline style colors instead of the design token classes (bg-volt / bg-borderStrong). Minor consistency nit; feature works.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 sessions in localStorage 'gymtrack_guest_sessions': two on Monday of this week (same day) and one on Wednesday of this week. Expected daysThisWeek=2, verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Meta Semanal feature is fully working. Verified: (1) home-goal-card renders when sessions>0; (2) home-goal-progress correctly shows '2 de 3 días' — two sessions on same day counted as 1 distinct day, plus one on different day = 2; (3) default goal is 3; (4) increase/decrease buttons work with min=1 / max=7 bounds and are correctly disabled at limits; (5) localStorage 'gymtrack_weekly_goal' persists across reload (tested with goal=5 and goal=1); (6) home-goal-dots renders Y segments with first X in volt (#D4FF00); (7) message flips to '¡Meta cumplida esta semana!' with Check icon (volt bg) when daysThisWeek >= weeklyGoal; (8) singular 'día' vs plural 'días' handled correctly at goal=1; (9) regression: home-streak-card and streak-share-modal (via home-streak-share-btn) still work.
